name: zeffect_handle_detach_event
description: zEffect::HandleDetachEvent updates a beam detach event over its duration, resolving points, applying beam geometry, returning in-progress/completed state, and consuming frame delta.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; coverage is functional through native detach event tests.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x45b4a0 validates null/negative-beam guards, beam node lookup, runState-0 point normalization flags, time-slice clamp to endTimeSec, point A/B node and vector resolution, optional segment fraction updates, UpdateBeamNodeBetweenPoints/Fractions dispatch, length-threshold in-progress result, elapsed-time in-progress result, frame-delta decrement, and default return 2.

The native parent/attach/detach smoke verifies the direct point path, UpdateBeamNodeBetweenPoints dispatch through HandleDetachEvent, in-progress return, beam geometry update, and frame-delta consumption.
